pairs.difference: Earphones go inside the ear; Headphones sit over the ears on a band.
A Smartwatch has a big screen, apps and calls; a Fitness Band is slim and mostly counts steps and sleep.
A Pen Drive is a tiny USB stick; a Hard Disk is a bigger box for backing up everything.
A Speaker is a box you carry to parties; a Soundbar is a long bar under the TV.
A Selfie Stick is a handheld pole; a Tripod stands on three legs.
A Printer puts paper out; a Scanner reads paper in.
A Trimmer cuts beard and hair; a Massager vibrates to relax sore muscles.
Earbuds are tiny, wireless and live in a charging case; a Neckband has a band that rests around your neck.
A Satellite Dish is round and points at the sky for DTH; an Antenna is the old rod on the rooftop for Doordarshan.
A Laptop has a keyboard and folds open; a Tablet is a touchscreen slab.
A Projector throws the picture onto a wall; a TV is its own screen.
A DSLR is big, with interchangeable lenses; an Action Camera is tiny, waterproof and mounted on helmets.
A Router gives you Wi-Fi; a Set-Top Box gives you TV channels.
A Hair Dryer blows hot air; a Straightener clamps hair between hot plates.
A CCTV camera watches shops and gates for security; a Baby Monitor watches a sleeping baby.
A Keyboard is for typing; a Joystick is a stick for playing games.
An Electric Scooter has a handlebar and you stand on a deck; a Hoverboard has no handle and you balance on two wheels.
A Charger powers one phone; an Extension Board gives you many sockets on a long wire.
A Polaroid prints a photo instantly; a Camcorder records video, like old wedding tapes.
A Calculator does sums; a Typewriter types letters onto paper.
Both are remote-controlled. A Drone flies; a Remote Control Car drives.
A Weighing Scale measures your weight; a Thermometer measures your temperature.
Both have antennas. A Radio only listens; a Walkie-Talkie lets you talk back.
A Game Console plugs into the TV; a VR Headset goes over your eyes.
An Air Fryer cooks crispy food with little oil; an Air Purifier cleans the air in a room.
A Microphone picks up sound; a Webcam picks up video.
A Smartphone goes everywhere with you; a Landline is a corded phone fixed at home.
Both are smart-home gadgets. A Robot Vacuum cleans the floor; a Smart Bulb changes colour from your phone.
